title: Wendy M Possible NDE 6456
content: When I entered the operating room and was given anesthesia, they told me to count. I opened my eyes but I had no body. I was seeing everything that was happening from the ceiling. I saw myself sleeping and the doctors operating on me. I was amazed to see that in the room there was another person who they were operating on. I thought, ‘Wow, the operating room is shared’. I was conscious that I was up above without a body, but it was a strange sensation. I was not scared at all; it was as if nothing mattered. I could see without eyes. Later, I watched as they transferred me out of the operating room to another place. The hours passed and I kept watching myself sleep, but I didn’t feel tired, nor was I hungry. It was a strange feeling. I watched as the nurses came to check on me frequently. I realized it was because it was past the time that I should have woken up, but I kept sleeping. The doctors got scared and I saw that they gave me a shot in my leg. I felt that whatever was holding me up above had broken, and all of the sudden I had a body. When I awoke, I thought that it was all a dream. Upon leaving the recovery room, I saw the boy that they had been operating on with me in the operating room. I realized that it really was true that my spirit had left my body.

out_of_body.separation_sensations_other: She reported having 'no body', not being scared, and that 'nothing mattered'.

environment.environment_other_detail: Operating room and later another place (recovery area) in the hospital.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Observed medical staff, self on operating table, transfer to recovery area, and another patient being operated on.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: OBE occurred under anesthesia with extended observation in hospital settings; no tunnel/light/life review/boundary described; then sudden return when given a shot.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: She reported seeing another person being operated on in the same operating room and later identified the boy afterward, which reinforced her conclusion that it was not a dream.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “I opened my eyes but I had no body.” “I was seeing everything that was happening from the ceiling.” “I could see without eyes.” “I felt that whatever was holding me up above had broken, and all of the sudden I had a body.”
